title: Finding Safe Water
description: Ranks water sources in three tiers and explains where to find water in urban, rural, and wilderness settings. Covers rain, ground, transpiration bag, solar still, dew, and tree collection, judging water quality, sources to avoid, and tapping water heaters, pipes, and toilet tanks at home.
shortDescription: Ranked water sources, collection methods, and hidden water at home
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
